title: An extension of finitely generated modules is finitely generated
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $M_1\xrightarrow{f}M_2\xrightarrow{g}M_3\to0$ be $R$-linear maps of $R$-modules with $\operatorname{im}f=\ker g$ and $g$ surjective (for instance a short exact sequence $0\to M_1\to M_2\to M_3\to0$). If $M_1$ and $M_3$ are finitely generated $R$-modules [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], then $M_2$ is a finitely generated $R$-module.
